item.title: 7 Side hustles to boost your income in Nairobi
item.description: Are you looking to make extra income while maintaining your job? Finding a perfect side hustle that will not take more of your time can be exhausting. In this article, we list out easy side hustles that you can implement within a day and start making extra income.

item.title: Tips to help you improve your productivity at the workplace
item.description: A lot of people feel frustrated at the end of the day having to battle the feeling of accomplishing less than they expected. Improved productivity is not magic and achievable by everyone. These few tips will help you plan out your day well and increase your level of productivity.

item.title: The Importance of Proofreading Your CV
item.description: Your CV is your first impression to potential employers, and even the smallest mistake can cost you a job opportunity. A well-polished, error free CV demonstrates professionalism, attention to detail, and credibility. Proofreading your CV is an essential step in ensuring it effectively communicates your skills and experience while avoiding costly errors.

item.title: The Importance of an ATS-Optimized CV.
item.description: In today's competitive job market, getting your CV noticed by recruiters and hiring managers is more challenging than ever. Many companies now rely on Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to streamline the hiring process, filtering CVs before they even reach a human recruiter. If your CV is not optimized for ATS, it may never be seen no matter how qualified you are for the job.

item.title: Why You Should Revamp Your CV Today
item.description: Your CV is your professional introduction, the first impression you make on potential employers. Yet, many job seekers use the same outdated CV for years without realizing that a stale, poorly structured resume can cost them valuable opportunities. Whether you are actively job hunting or simply keeping your options open, here’s why you should revamp your CV today.

item.title: The Importance of Customizing Your CV to the Job Description
item.description: In a competitive job market, submitting a generic CV can significantly reduce your chances of landing an interview. Hiring managers and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) prioritize candidates whose CVs align closely with the job description. Customizing your CV ensures that you showcase the most relevant skills, experience, and achievements for the role you’re applying for, giving you a competitive edge.

item.title: The Modern CV
item.description: In 2025, the job market is evolving rapidly, and employers are looking for more than just a list of job responsibilities. They want to see skills, impact, and adaptability. A modern CV goes beyond the traditional format and emphasizes clarity, relevance, and brevity while showcasing your most important achievements. It must be designed to grab attention quickly and align with the demands of today’s fast paced recruitment landscape.

item.title: Why You Should Keep Your LinkedIn Profile Updated in 2025.
item.description: In today’s fast paced and competitive job market, your LinkedIn profile is more than just an online resume; it’s your digital professional identity. Whether you’re actively job hunting, exploring new opportunities, or growing your personal brand, maintaining an up to date LinkedIn profile is essential.

item.title: What Makes a Great CV in 2025
item.description: Your CV is still one of the most powerful tools in your career toolbox but the expectations around it have evolved. In today’s fast paced, digital first hiring landscape, a great CV is not just a list of jobs; it’s a compelling snapshot of your value, impact, and potential.

item.title: The Role of Professional Email Communication in Your Job Sea
item.description: When applying for a job, the email you send is often your very first point of contact with a potential employer. It acts as a digital handshake; one that can either open doors or close them immediately. In today’s fast-paced job market, where first impressions count more than ever, the way you craft and send your job application email reflects not only your professionalism but also your attention to detail and communication skills.
